personality: 3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT combined with 6 Glass / Luxe DARK for the Altar screen
personality_one_liner: A warm, sacred, and deeply emotional digital chapel that balances the solemnity of classical Catholic devotions with premium editorial typography and cinematic depth.

spacing.rule: Generous, breathable editorial margins. Do not cramp content. Use spacing to create moments of reflection.

do's: Use dark frosted glass panels over the Altar background to hold daily readings or prayers without blocking the candle's glow.
Use subtle blur on the bottom tab bar to allow scrolling content to gently ghost underneath.
dont's: Do not apply glass to readable body text blocks or dense form fields.
Do not use highly reflective white glass on the Altar screen; keep it muted, dark, and warm.

screens.name: Altar (Home)
screens.purpose: A deeply personal and spiritual home screen functioning as a virtual altar centered around lighting a virtual candle for an intention.

states.loading: Centered minimalist gold cross or fading candle outline on a dark warm background.
states.empty: Prompt to 'Select your Patron Saint' to construct your personal altar.
states.error: Message: 'Unable to prepare your altar at this time.' with a soft gold Retry button.

screens.layout: CRITICAL: This entire screen MUST use the dark theme ('surfaceInverse' #1C0F0E background) to emulate a dimly lit chapel. Top: Greeting and streak counter. Center: Large, immersive animated candle (fluid Lottie/Skia flame) that acts as the emotional core. Below the candle: Floating glass or 'brandPrimary' tinted cards for Daily Gospel + Audio Meditation, and Morning/Night Prayers.

screens.name: Muro (Community Intentions)
screens.purpose: A public wall of prayer requests where users can pray for each other.

states.loading: Skeleton rows resembling parchment prayer cards.
states.empty: Illustration of folded hands with text: 'Be the first to share an intention today.'
states.error: Message: 'Could not load community intentions.' with a Retry button.

screens.layout: Uses the light Ivory ('surface') theme. Top: Segmented filter pills (Recent, Health, Family, Thanksgiving). Body: Feed of intention cards. Each card uses 'surfaceSecondary', features elegant serif typography for the name, and a prominent 'Rezo por ti' (I pray for you) button in 'brandSecondary' (Gold). Avoid rigid dashboards; arrange cards with generous 'lg' padding.

screens.name: Misa (Live Sunday Mass)
screens.purpose: A virtual gathering space to watch the weekly Sunday Mass with community chat.

states.loading: Loading spinner over a blurred chapel image.
states.empty: Countdown timer to the next Sunday Mass prominently displayed over a beautiful church interior photo.
states.error: Message: 'Could not connect to the live stream.' with Retry button.

screens.layout: Light or Dark theme based on live status. Top half: 16:9 YouTube embed container with gradient scrim. Bottom half: Split between an active community chat feed and a beautifully formatted schedule. Use classical alignment and generous spacing. Add a sticky primary CTA 'Donate to Collection' at the bottom.

screens.name: Causas (Social Impact)
screens.purpose: A transparent voting and reporting system for the community's monthly charitable donations.

states.loading: Skeleton of candidate cards with progress bars.
states.empty: Message: 'New causes are being prepared for next month.'
states.error: Message: 'Unable to load causes.' with Retry button.

screens.layout: Light Ivory ('surface') theme. Top: Editorial-style header 'Cause of the Month' and current revenue percentage tracker. Middle: Candidate cards showing high-quality photos (with top-to-bottom dark gradient scrims for readable text), descriptions, and a prominent 'Votar' (Vote) button. Bottom: Transparency panel showing past funded causes with before/after photo galleries.

altar_background.alt: Warm glow of candles inside a church in Vienna, creating a serene atmosphere.

saint_card_jesus.alt: A detailed painting of the Sacred Heart of Jesus displayed indoors with ornate decor.

charity_impact_card.alt: Volunteers organizing donation boxes with clothes and food items in a community center.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The 'Altar' screen must strictly use the dark theme (surfaceInverse: #1C0F0E) to simulate a dimly lit, sacred chapel environment. The rest of the app should use the light Ivory theme (surface: #FDFBF7) to ensure high readability for older demographics.
Do not use generic blue/purple default palettes or UI toolkits (Tailwind/Shadcn). Stick explicitly to the Sacred Heart Red (#8B0000), Gold (#C5A059), and Ivory palette provided in the colors block.
The primary feature is the virtual candle. You MUST use an animated Lottie or Skia component for the candle flame to make it feel alive and emotional. A static image is not acceptable.

Typography MUST load 'CormorantGaramond' for Display/Serif and 'LibreFranklin' for Body/Sans via expo-font. Ensure font sizes are heavily weighted toward the 'lg' and 'xl' tokens for older audience accessibility.
Any text overlaid on imagery (like the Saint cards or Charity candidate cards) MUST have a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to 70%+ surfaceInverse) underneath it to guarantee WCAG contrast.
The 'Rezo por ti' button on the Muro screen should be a prominent, easily tappable target with haptic feedback wired to it.
When building the layout, lean into editorial spacing. Give the content room to breathe to convey dignity and reflection rather than overwhelming the user with a dense dashboard.
